x-card.description: Read selected log files over SSH without running shell commands.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: The core connects from this machine, so your VPN and hosts file apply.

username.title: User
username.description: A dedicated account with read access to the selected logs.

privateKeyPath.title: Private key file
privateKeyPath.description: An absolute path on this computer or ~/…; OpenSSH or PEM. The file is read locally and is never uploaded.

logs.title: Log format

root.title: Remote log folder
root.description: Choose an absolute folder on the SSH server. Symbolic links are not followed.

allowedFiles.title: Allowed log files
allowedFiles.description: Exact file paths relative to the selected folder. New or rotated names are not allowed automatically.

format.title: Format
format.description: Auto detects JSON objects per line and otherwise reads plain text.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: Used only when a timestamp has no UTC offset. Use an IANA zone such as Europe/Madrid or UTC. Ambiguous daylight-saving times are reported as unparsed.

timestampField.title: JSON timestamp field
timestampField.description: Optional exact field name, dotted path or JSON Pointer, such as @timestamp, event.time or /event/time. Empty detects @timestamp, timestamp, time or ts.

levelField.title: JSON level field
levelField.description: Optional exact field name, dotted path or JSON Pointer. Empty detects level, severity or log.level.

timestampPattern.title: Timestamp pattern
timestampPattern.description: Optional Java date-time pattern for the text prefix or JSON timestamp, for example uuuu-MM-dd HH:mm:ss,SSS. Empty recognizes ISO timestamps and common year-month-day text dates. Include the year; dates without a year are not inferred.

timestampUnit.title: Numeric timestamp unit
timestampUnit.description: Unit of numeric timestamps in JSON Lines. Text date strings are parsed independently.

logs.description: Parse text logs and JSON Lines for time and level filters. Each physical line is one record; timestamps without an offset use the configured time zone.

pinned.description: Filled by Test connection after you confirm the fingerprint.
pinned.title: Trusted host keys

knownHosts.description: Optional known_hosts lines, hashed lines too.
knownHosts.title: Known hosts
